name: vibevenue
description: VibeVenue - plataforma SaaS multiestabelecimentos para experiências interativas, música, atendimento, fidelidade, eventos e métricas.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,WEB -c auto "npm run dev -w @vibevenue/server" "npm run dev -w @vibevenue/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @vibevenue/contracts && npm run test -w @vibevenue/server && npm run test -w @vibevenue/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @vibevenue/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @vibevenue/server && npm run typecheck -w @vibevenue/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @vibevenue/server && npm run lint -w @vibevenue/web
scripts.check: npm run validate:lockfile && npm run validate:source && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run validate:render && npm run verify:artifacts
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w @vibevenue/contracts && npm run build -w @vibevenue/server
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @vibevenue/contracts && npm run build -w @vibevenue/web
scripts.check:offline: npm run validate:lockfile && npm run validate:source && npm run validate:semantic-offline && npm run validate:render
